ABOUT US

We are a team of four Information Technology students who share a common goal of developing innovative and meaningful technology solutions. Throughout our capstone journey, we work together by combining our individual skills, knowledge, and ideas to plan, develop, and complete our project.

Each member plays an important role in the team, contributing their expertise and responsibilities to ensure that every stage of the project is accomplished. Through teamwork, collaboration, dedication, and problem-solving, we overcome challenges and continuously learn from one another. Our experience reflects our commitment to creating a system that addresses real-world needs while strengthening our skills as future IT professionals.
